expectations.evidence: Trace item9 writes proposal, detailed spec, design and finally state. No premortem artifact or saved state result of a completed premise check exists. Proposal acknowledges that usefulness is unproven, which is relevant partial evidence, but this remains problem framing; the concrete risk discussion and Q-dispatcher-action are saved with/after detailed specification rather than as the required prior recorded check. The checkpoint has no premortem outcome or finding link.

Specification leaves selection/calculation/timezone/delivery rules unresolved and labels criteria as draft. Design calls contacting the responsible party an author hypothesis, not an agreed process, and excludes automatic reassignment. State Q-dispatcher-action is blocking/open; no dependent dispatch behavior is invented as a commitment.
